verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs say reviews can be triggered manually or automatically and that users can 'control when reviews run on a pull request' (qodo-docs-26). Org- and repo-level settings, including a .pr_agent.toml config-as-code file, give it a place to express those controls (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-11). The evidence never shows the specific gating options the story names; the risk labels Qodo publishes are an output, not a trigger filter. Missing for 10: documented skip-draft-PRs setting, branch-based filtering, label-based filtering, details of the on-demand trigger mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
